svg.title: The board request is reduced to roles
svg.desc: Arrange backup, announcement, proposed irreversible action and observation as separate roles. Keep the action conditional and its operational contents redacted. Visual distinction: A ratchet edge and an unpressed control identify a one-way action. No crossing arrow or activated state establishes an outcome.
